name: WHOI Robots4Whales live buoy detections
note: Real right whale up-calls from the WHOI near real-time buoy maccb2606 (Cape Cod Bay by default), 29 Sep - 28 Nov 2026 00:00 UTC, counted every 15 minutes by the buoy's automatic detector (Baumgartner lab, WHOI; many periods not yet analyst-reviewed) and refreshed hourly. Hours the buoy was not listening are missing, not zero. SST: NOAA MUR SST v4.1 via ERDDAP.
